1 submitted that as far as the present applicant is concerned, who is working with the accused No.5 and merely because he is working with the accused No.5 he is implicated in the alleged offence.
He submitted that the other co-accused are already released on bail by this Court by granting them protection.

As As far as role of the present applicant is concerned,
his custodial interrogation is not required.
He has not played any role in forgery as well as accepting the amount.
In view of that, he be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

4. Learned APP strongly opposed the said application on the ground that in perusal of the conspiracy, the amount was accepted by the co-accused and forged appointment letter was issued to the complainant.
Thus, the custodial interrogation is required.
In view of that, the prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be rejected.

5. After hearing the learned Counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State, perused the recitals of the FIR from which it reveals that the applicant was serving with the accused No.5 namely Pankaj Vairagade and as an employee of said Pankaj  (3) 12.aba.512.2024 Vairagade he has accepted the documents as well as made a phone call.
As far as his involvement in the forgery of the documents or accepting the amount is not reveals from the recitals of the FIR.

Moreover,
the other co-accused are already protected by this Court by granting ad-interim anticipatory bail.
In view of that, the prayer for grant of ad-interim protection deserves to be allowed.

Accordingly I proceed to pass following order:
 ORDER (i)

In the event of arrest, in connection with Crime No.186/2023 registered with Police Station,
Sonegaon, Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 465, 468, 471 and 120-B read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, the applicant Purushottam Gajanan Meshram shall be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail on executing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount.
(ii) The applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station once in a week on Sunday between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
(iii) The applicant shall furnish his cell phone number and address with the address proof.
